edits.text: Government regulators/agencies (e.g. CRTC) are `government-organization`; the UN, its agencies and international NGOs are `international-organization`; militaries and militant groups are `armed-organization`; 以军-type abbreviations are decomposed into 军队 :possessor-of a `country` with :name (not an organization with :name);

edits.anchor: Verbs with no frame (守节, 惨死, 查访, 上报) get -01; only broadcast words such as 启播, 回放 keep -00.
edits.text: Verbs with no PropBank frame get -00 (遇袭, 葬, 穿着, 不治身亡 kept as one predicate), while verbs with a frame use the fitting -0N sense. Broadcast words such as 启播, 回放 keep -00.
- Aspectual, sequencing, deictic and focus adverbs (曾, 已经, 都, 随即, 当时, 还是, 首先 as :temporal only if non-sequencing) are not concept nodes; their meaning goes into aspect and document-level relations.

edits.anchor: Approximators (约) are a node with the number as :quant;
edits.text: Approximators (约) are a node with the number as :op1;

edits.anchor: 首次 is an :ord ordinal-entity with :unit 次 and :value 1.
edits.text: 首次 and 第N次 are an :ord ordinal-entity with only :value (never a :unit 次); an event count like 两次/3次 is have-frequency-91 (ARG2 count) or :frequency.

edits.anchor: Clauses contrasted by 而…则, 则 or 并未 are `and-contrast`, not `and`.
edits.text: Clauses contrasted by 而…则 or 则 are `contrast-91` with :ARG1/:ARG2, not `and`.

edits.text: - Event nominals denoting a concrete occurrence (空袭, 袭击, 援助, 救援, 追杀, 事发, 武装, 行驶, 安全, 裁决, 行动) are -01 events with aspect, modal and temporal relations, also as modifiers; 工作人员 is 人员 :ARG0-of 工作-01. Only abstract nouns (旌表, 记载, 建造, 守节 inside a noun phrase) are bare concepts without sense, aspect, temporal or modal relations;
- A demonstrative with or without classifier (该, 这次, 本次, 这场) is a :mod concept. 'X事件' keeps 事件 as head, identity-91 with the event X-01.

- Part nouns such as 南部/中部/北部 head the phrase and link to the whole by :part-of (city part-of 南部 part-of region), not :mod or :place. A location noun 位置/地点 of an event is linked by :place-of, not :possessor or ARG1-of.

- Sequenced clauses (后, 随即, 尔后) are a `consecutive` coordination; clauses sharing a subject that follow a comma are grouped in a nested `and` under the main coordination, not one flat `and`. 其中 'among them' is include-91 (ARG2 the whole group, ARG1 the subset), not coordination.

- 根据 X (的说法) is have-source-91 with ARG2 the source, not a 根据-01 event. 简称 is 简称-01 (aspect state) with ARG1 the entity and ARG2 the abbreviation name. 发动 + event noun and 遭到 + event are events whose ARG1 is the nested event.

- Distance/extent: the measured quantity of 长达, 相隔/隔 and 离 is a core argument (not :extent); 离 uses 离-02 (ARG0 thing, ARG1 reference, ARG2 distance); 仅 is :mod on the quantity. 'N units before X' is a temporal-quantity with :mod 前 (:op1 X) attached by :temporal.

- Aspect: ongoing 正在 events, 封锁, 行驶, 逃跑, 前往, 运送, 存放 and 继续 are activity; 逃命 is endeavor; 保证, 安全, 致力于 and identity-91 are state; bounded completed or requested events (进入, 抢救, 服役, 道歉) are performance. Every event node gets aspect, modal and temporal relations; abstract predicates (have-cause-91, include-91) do not.

suggestions: Provide the annotator a list of UMR named-entity types so it picks the most specific one (international-organization, armed-organization, nationality, facility).
Give a checklist step requiring every event node to receive aspect and modal edges before output.
